head_commit.message:
build(deps): bump the cargo-minor-patch group (#340)

Bumps the cargo-minor-patch group in /desktop/src-tauri with 2 updates: [tauri-plugin-notification](https://github.com/tauri-apps/plugins-workspace) and [tauri-plugin-store](https://github.com/tauri-apps/plugins-workspace).


Updates `tauri-plugin-notification` from 2.8.0 to 2.8.1
- [Release notes](https://github.com/tauri-apps/plugins-workspace/releases)
- [Commits](https://github.com/tauri-apps/plugins-workspace/compare/log-v2.8.0...http-v2.8.1)

Updates `tauri-plugin-store` from 2.5.0 to 2.5.1
- [Release notes](https://github.com/tauri-apps/plugins-workspace/releases)
- [Commits](https://github.com/tauri-apps/plugins-workspace/compare/fs-v2.5.0...fs-v2.5.1)

---
updated-dependencies:
- dependency-name: tauri-plugin-notification
  dependency-version: 2.8.1
  dependency-type: direct:production
  update-type: version-update:semver-patch
  dependency-group: cargo-minor-patch
- dependency-name: tauri-plugin-store
  dependency-version: 2.5.1
  dependency-type: direct:production
  update-type: version-update:semver-patch
  dependency-group: cargo-minor-patch
...

Signed-off-by: dependabot[bot] <support@github.com>
Co-authored-by: dependabot[bot] <49699333+dependabot[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>
